purpose: Create the first genuine Exilada body pixel-art candidate by direct pixel-art authoring from the already-locked visual references, not by reducing/filtering them and not by asking the user to generate more reference material.

logical_target.background: transparent preferred; otherwise one flat removable background

native_pixel_art_contract.pixel_clusters: deliberate connected clusters authored for native gameplay readability
native_pixel_art_contract.palette_target: controlled value/color groups; exact count is secondary to intentional cluster design

allowed: validate native-grid consistency of already-authored pixel art
remove a flat background to alpha without altering silhouette
measure visible height and bounds without rescaling the body
hash and package an approved 2D asset
forbidden: resize the locked references into the final sprite
quantize or pixel-filter a painting/render and call it pixel art
mechanically trace a reference silhouette into final production geometry
procedurally invent or repair final human anatomy and call that authored art
shift routine manual repainting burden to the user

visual_pass: reads immediately as intentional modern pixel art at native 1x
preserves approved adult Exilada proportions and body mass
face, hands, feet, chest, pelvis and legs are deliberately simplified for the grid rather than collapsed by reduction
silhouette is authored for gameplay readability
value grouping is cluster-based rather than render-like
retains mature severe sensual dangerous sword-and-sorcery presence
does not read as a pixelated photo/render, procedural mannequin, generic fitness model or low-resolution 3D
failure_policy: Reject the authoring method/candidate; do not ask the user for another body reference and do not rescue failed art with mechanical filters.
next_action: Assistant owns selection/implementation of a valid native-pixel authoring path from the fixed references. No further user reference-generation request is permitted.
next_if_pass: Promote the accepted native-grid image to the persistent B3B 2D body source, then add deterministic import/QA/export tooling before B4.
next_if_fail: Keep B3B current and revise the authoring implementation while preserving the fixed-reference lock.
